audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of the first five Science House records: Demetrius’s soil-sample conversation, its truth branch, Maru’s burn accident, the tomato-classification dispute, and Robin’s woodworking lesson. Every line, embedded question, response option, conditional and gender branch, scientific and medical detail, recipe title, and family voice was reviewed in full event context with canonical Maru, Demetrius and Robin terminology. Event commands, actors, movement, timing, friendship and prior-choice conditions, response IDs, placeholders, runtime gender selector, branch delimiters, emotion markers, music and sound IDs, and non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. The remaining Science House records are handled separately. The full-locale final audits remain pending.
